Don’t let the flu get you: Health agencies share tips for Pinoys
results.description: Health agencies shared tips to help Filipinos protect themselves against Influenza-Like Illnesses (ILI) amid the spread of coughs and colds. The Department of Health (DOH) said ILI is an infection caused by different viruses and bacteria that affects the nose, throat, and lungs.
